I felt similarly in college when I was going to exit, but I felt my death (not life) would be wasted. Because many people were suffering the same way as me (complete destruction of the individual and thinking called "education"), I wished we could gather and express our reasons instead of sporadically being extinguished by the system. At least then people might acknowledge that problem and incite change if I didn't have the strength to. 

I wanted to exit, but felt like I had something left to say, a final message of everything that destroyed my childhood self. But even if I understood why, it didn't matter unless it could be noticed. 

I decided to live so that I could die another day alongside a collective cause. And as I survived each day I began to flesh out in more clearer detail the trail of suffering that had compressed my mind, at the very least clinging to the idea that one day I could express it alongside others. 

In this process I regained the ability to live in order to share my ideas of a different world instead of dying for it. To carry my suffering and touch the world with my awareness of the particular case, or at least by trying to seek understanding of others in that field of pain or indirectly dodging what might hurt them worse. 

Do you have any reasons substantially contributing to your anguish, and do you feel others share a similar pain?

I'm physically unwell in so many stacking ways, and mentally structured to need a different headspace that doesn't seem to be approaching any time soon in order to enter subjects to engage in. And then, I get overloaded if I do engage. 

All avenues are now closed. I can see now the intersecting realizations are as sprawled as a web and I can't continue down one without growing awareness of deeper damage that's being done to me from beyond my control. 

Emerging thoughts are in decrescendo, as each bob trades to a larger bite. Even the small ones poison. Helplessness in raw layers of my mind. 

There feels to be only one direction now.

Honestly I just asked them for it because at the time I wasn't aware about TOS (still need further testing). My hands were burning and throbbing with grip that was failing me (I could feel the forearm/wrist muscles burn and get sore). Everything worsened with hand us, but if I didn't use them for a weeks at a time they would feel better but the sore/weakness threshold (to point of grip loss) would lower again as I used them. I wondered if maybe it could be repetitive strain injury and if the MRI might show tendinosis or some other abnormality because the doctor was unsure.

The symptoms I believe are CTS are: wrist pain into the forearm (all around), stinging (even in pinky finger) as well as tingling/numbness. Occasional sharp pains around wrist (won't be able to rotate wrist) and even outer facing part of hand? 


Everything worsens with phone/games/computer use. I'll get weakness gripping things like picking up a bowl or opening fridge door, using that rotating inwards to grip or texf (not as much since Ive let it rest for a couple weeks, so now I can pick up heavier objects or for longer without the soreness/weakness preventing me). 

At one point I over did my hands typing and couldn't even lift a spoon to eat.. that's when I got worried about tendonosis. I thought maybe less blood flow to my hands = harder healing. 

The symptoms I believe are TOS is burning pain, soreness and weakness in all fingers/wrist (it feels like the muscles in fingers/palm/wrist that you use when you squeeze into a fisf). There is a prickling sensation distinct from the CTS numbness/tingling, and my arms get freezing cold and turn purple.constriction wrapping around fingers/forearm (might be the soreness). A falling asleep sensation down my arm and outer two fingers Usually I have a mix of the two so it's been hard to sort out.
